limitations: SSE is notification, not permission. Application recovery requires durable receipts.
name: application

limitations: Explicit trusted development only. Docker is not a hostile-code production boundary. Runtime network is disabled; dependency builds use npm/PyPI with integrity locks and disabled lifecycle/source builds. Images are local to the registered worker. No automatic reexecution of lost claims.
name: local_compute

limitations: Requests are sent once. A lost response is uncertain, not automatically retried.
name: http

limitations: Per-session rooted namespace; no recursive delete. A directory may contain at most 4096 entries for bounded listing. Local storage does not migrate between machines.
name: local_storage

limitations: Separate agent bucket and credentials are required. Object storage does not support atomic directory rename or append.
name: s3_storage

limitations: Separate agent bucket and credentials are required. Object storage does not support atomic directory rename or append.
name: r2_storage

limitations: Public HTTP(S), ports 80/443 only. No private destinations, browser execution, cookies or unrestricted request headers.
name: web_fetch

limitations: Brave Web Search. Country, language, safesearch and freshness are provider-specific options. No silent provider fallback.
name: brave

limitations: Tavily Search. Search depth, topic and domain filtering retain provider semantics. No silent provider fallback.
name: tavily

limitations: Exa Search. Search type, category, domain filtering and publication dates retain provider semantics. No silent provider fallback.
name: exa

limitations: Streamable HTTP, protocols 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18. Each invocation initializes its own protocol session. No opaque tool retry or native process continuation.
name: mcp
